messages.S2「振動弾」で大量の振動を入れ、振動編成の味方の条件を一気に満たす供給役(準備: A supplier that uses S2 Quake Rounds to immediately apply large amounts of Tremor and fulfill allies' Tremor conditions without preparation. S3 Suppress's Rupture and 5 Fragile raise the damage of allies acting later that turn.
messages.S2「振動弾」: Ⅱ・Ⅲコインでそれぞれ弾丸を1消耗し、振動4/8を付与して振動: **S2 — Quake Rounds**: Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ each spend 1 Ammo to inflict 4/8 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2. Coin Ⅰ inflicts 1 Attack Power Down without Ammo.
messages.S3「制圧」: Ⅰコインで振動爆発。Ⅱ〜Ⅳコインで弾丸を1ずつ消耗し、Ⅱ・Ⅲで破: **S3 — Suppress**: Coin Ⅰ triggers Tremor Burst. Coins Ⅱ–Ⅳ each spend 1 Ammo; Ⅱ and Ⅲ inflict 4 Rupture and 2 Rupture Count, and Ⅳ inflicts 5 Fragile. +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 5 Tremor Count.
messages.デバフは1ターン限り: 脆弱・攻撃威力減少は1ターンの間だけ効く。速度範囲値が最: **Debuffs last only 1 turn**: Fragile and Attack Power Down only last for 1 turn. Her Speed range is a slow 2–6 at most, so having later allies benefit requires adjusting action order.
messages.弾丸は有限: S2のⅡ・Ⅲ、S3のⅡ〜Ⅳが弾丸を消耗する。弾丸が尽きるとこれらの: **Ammo is limited**: Coins Ⅱ and Ⅲ of S2 and Ⅱ–Ⅳ of S3 spend Ammo. Once Ammo runs out, those Coins can no longer attack. She has 13 rounds at stage start, which run out in about 8 turns if she keeps using S2 and S3.
messages.挑発値: S1「押し付ける」と守備「ガード」は使用時に次のターンの挑発値+4(守: **Aggro**: S1 Shove and the Defense skill Guard grant +4 Aggro next turn on use (+2 more for the Defense skill at 0 Ammo). Aggro only matters in Focused Encounters. S1 inflicts 1/3 Paralyze on Coin Ⅰ hit (Heads Hit/on hit) and gains +2 Skill Power if the target has at least 8 Tremor.
messages.振動を扱う味方と組み、S2で一気に振動を入れて味方の振動系スキルの条件を満たす。: Pair her with allies who use Tremor, and apply a burst of Tremor with S2 to meet allies' Tremor skill conditions. S3's Tremor Burst is a bonus; the real goal is inflicting Rupture and 5 Fragile to boost the follow-up attacks that same turn. Ammo is limited, so save S2 and S3 for moments when their effects matter, and once Ammo runs out, switch to drawing attacks with the Aggro from S1 and her Defense skill in Focused Encounters.
